## Bridging Borders with Africa: Navigating Africa’s Illiquid Currencies with Jenzy
###### June 5, 2026
We also spotlight [**Jenzy**](https://www.jenzy.com/), a company transforming how money moves across some of Africa's most illiquid currency corridors by intelligently routing transactions across multiple payment rails to reduce payment failures and settlement delays, drawing on insights from CEO and Co-Founder, [Eniola Ajuwon](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ajuwon/).
